modules.title: Analysis-relative existence in the Abhidharmakośabhāṣya
modules.formal_scope: This module reconstructs the analytical contrast discussed around *Abhidharmakośabhāṣya* VI.4.  Physical destruction and mental analysis are tagged separately.  A framework also keeps transformation, admissibility, and continued recognition separate.  An object is `ParamarthaSat` here when its recognition survives every admitted analysis; it is `SamvrtiSat` when an admitted analysis supplies a recognition-loss witness.
